label.description: The text label for the input field.

value.description: The value of the text field.

variant.description: The type of input field to display. Values: `shortText` is a single-line text input; `longText` is a multi-line text input for longer content; `number` is a numeric input; `obscured` hides typed characters for passwords or other sensitive values.

validationRegexp.description: A regular expression used for client-side validation of the input.
